comments.body: Warning: The FreeBSD parts are only compile-tested.

I think the FreeBSD parts look fine but I'm not able to test the xattr changes right now.

Work on FreeBSD Podman has slowed down this year while we sort out a FreeBSD port of Netavark. Once that is working (hopefully towards the end of this year or early in 2027), I plan to spend some time testing Podman 6.x on FreeBSD and I'll deal with any fallout then.
